headerDisplay: **HomeMatic (BidCos-RF) / HomematicIP (HmIP-RF)** plugin for a CCU / OpenCCU, using XML-RPC only. Use the **custom UI** below to discover devices and map channels to HomeKit.
footerDisplay: Hard fork of [Homebridge-Homematic-HAP](https://github.com/matthiaseinig/Homebridge-Homematic-HAP), which builds on [thkl/hap-homematic](https://github.com/thkl/hap-homematic) and [thkl/homebridge-homematic](https://github.com/thkl/homebridge-homematic). Apache-2.0.

ccuIp.title: CCU IP / hostname
ccuIp.description: Address of your CCU / OpenCCU / RaspberryMatic.

interfacePorts.title: XML-RPC port overrides
interfacePorts.description: XML-RPC ports of the CCU interfaces. Defaults: BidCos-RF 2001, HmIP-RF 2010; with TLS 42001 / 42010.

useTls.title: Use TLS to talk to CCU
useTls.description: XML-RPC over HTTPS (ports 42001 / 42010). The CCU's self-signed certificate is accepted.

rpcAuth.title: XML-RPC authentication
rpcAuth.description: HTTP Basic auth on the XML-RPC ports, only if enabled on the CCU (Settings → Control Panel → Security → Authentication).

host.title: Bind address
host.description: Local address the event server listens on. 0.0.0.0 = all interfaces.

callbackHost.title: Callback address
callbackHost.description: IP or hostname under which the CCU reaches this Homebridge host. Required.

watchdogSeconds.title: Watchdog (s)
watchdogSeconds.description: Re-init the RPC subscription if no events arrive within this window.
